text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Tamamo Cross has a number of victories under her belt…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer… There's somethin' important I wanna talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I worked hard in the series, yeah? Wouldn't you say that's worth somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yes indeed. And the thing is, I'm completely worn out from all those winning runs.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I think it's about time I cashed in on my prize! Hand it over, pal!
choice_data_list: Please, this is all I have!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Keep your damn wallet, dummy! You know what I mean!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our brisk gag exchange comes to an end.
choice_data_list: It's the hot spring ticket you want, right?
It's the hot spring ticket you want, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Right. Man… You're gettin' real good at playin' dumb, ya know. You even got the pacin' nailed down, haha.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We're practically a comedy duo at this point. Now, let's get goin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following our little comedy routine, we set off for the hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whew, the hot water sure was somethin'. It worked wonders on my bruises.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'm on the smaller side, ya know? Gettin' knocked about really wears me out.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I needed a nice, long soak… I've really been puttin' my body through the wringer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I kinda feel guilty about it, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross gives her body some much-overdue care.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Still, it's hard to let myself relax. I know this is supposed to be my reward, but…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I do feel a bit bad kickin' back in the hot springs without my family.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I promised I'd take 'em all to Arima someday.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nah, not that Arima. There's a famous hot spring in Kansai with the same name.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I always wanted to go, so I promised we'd all go together someday.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You made good on your promise to take me to the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I haven't made good on mine yet. I still haven't taken 'em to Arima Hot Springs…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, sorry to ruin the mood. …Maybe I'm not thinkin' straight after sittin' in that hot water for so long.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Go where?
choice_data_list: To Arima Hot Springs, with your family.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You sure 'bout that? First you brought me here, and now you wanna spoil my folks too…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Tamamo Cross is racing to make her family happy…
choice_data_list: Our ultimate goal should be the Arima Hot Springs, not the Arima Kinen.
Our ultimate goal should be the Arima Hot Springs, not the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hahaha… That was a good one, I'll give ya that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I can't even think of a good comeback. You're one heck of a…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: All this time I've been working towards… towards Arima Hot Springs, and…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Mom, Dad… I… I did it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross, miles away from her family, is struck by a wave of homesickness.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Argh, that's enough of that! I'm not gonna sit around bein' wishy-washy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer, we're gonna enjoy the hell outta this onsen! You're gonna look like a raisin by the time ya get outta the water!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hot springs have always been on my to-go list! And I'm gettin' my ticket's worth tonight!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross's family-related guilt fades and she enjoys her time at the resort with childlike glee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense that Tamamo Cross and I have formed an irreplaceable bond.
